## Problem / motivation

What are you trying to do, and what's missing or hard today?

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see. Include which component it touches (contracts / circuits /
SDK / services / frontend / docs).

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about.

## Additional context

Anything else — links, prior art, constraints. Note that the **frozen native STX
core** is intentionally immutable; new protocol work generally belongs in the
SIP-10 layer or above.
